text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin successfully made her mark
during her "first three years"
in the Twinkle Series.
Watching that small body defeat powerhouse rivals gave courage to all who watched, and—
By now, she had become wildly popular.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin-san!
We would love to do an interview with you—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Count me in too, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah...

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin-san!
Could I please get your autograph!?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Fine by me, though.

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
I'll treasure this for the rest of my life!!

text_block_list.name: Gamer A
text_block_list.text: Oh? Isn't that Taishin playing around over there?

text_block_list.name: Gamer B
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
Can I challenge you to a match then?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. That's, like, super exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting way too many interview requests,
and people keep calling out to me just walking down the street...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I really just can't stand noisy places.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I really just want a little bit of quiet time
to myself, you know...
choice_data_list: Should I head home too, then?
Should I head home too, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Enough—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I mean...
Um, you don't... have to go home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I don't really mind, Trainer.

Afterward—Narita Taishin and I
quietly reminisced about our time together,
from the day we met until now.

That day we first met,
how I fell in love with that finishing kick—
The Satsuki Sho that marked a turning point, and the "Big Three" showdown alongside the other two from BNW—

And—
the victory in the Arima Kinen, seized through sheer tenacity.

"Though few words were exchanged,
the peaceful conversation flowed on,
and before they knew it, darkness had completely fallen."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, it's night already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I'm late, Creek gets on my case...
Or rather, she worries way too much, so I'd better get going...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you know...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I ran only to be recognized.
Running in races was no different.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All I cared about was running, winning, and earning recognition through my results.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Right now? I like it, actually. Quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Running, racing...
I... actually kinda like it.
Narita Taishin smiled as she said that.
—She laughed with genuine joy.
